caption: The drawing features a wooden chair frame depicted in a reddish-brown color, positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The chair is composed of curved and straight wooden elements, with two arched legs on each side connected by horizontal struts at the front, middle, and back. The armrests are also curved, extending from the top of the backrest down to the front legs, and attached with visible bolts or fasteners. The backrest consists of two vertical supports joined by a curved horizontal board at the top and a straight horizontal piece below it. The composition is centered on a blank, unadorned background, and the outline of the frame is bounding the drawing. In the lower left corner, the name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" is printed.
title: Child's Folding Chair
